title: Shelf — a small library you can run
tagline: A teacher's own application, carried through every phase.
description: Shelf keeps the books a small library owns: a Python API that adds, lists and lends books, and a React page that shows them in shelf order. You will write a missing story, sketch the contract, implement the marked gaps in both layers, prove the behaviour with tests, package the API, and ship a change request that reorders the shelf.
